title: lithocarpus obliquinervius
intro: Lithocarpus obliquinervius, commonly known as the Taiwanese Lithocarpus, is a species of plant in the beech family (Fagaceae). This plant is rich in bioactive compounds and has been traditionally used in medicine for its various health benefits. The health benefits of Lithocarpus obliquinervius include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antibacterial properties, which are attributed to its ability to prevent cell damage, reduce inflammation, and fight against infections. The bioactive constituents of Lithocarpus obliquinervius include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which exert therapeutic actions such as improving cardiovascular health, reducing cancer risk, and modulating the immune system.
